newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Homes to acquire Legacy Homes.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Homes to acquire Legacy Homes.

text.p: Monterey Homes Corp, a single-family home builder based in Arizona, on Friday said it has agreed to acquire Legacy Homes, a privately held home builder with headquarters in the Dallas/Fort Worth area.
Monterey will pay with 666,667 shares of its common stock and an option to acquire additional common. Monterey shares were up 1/2 at 6-1/2 at mid-afternoon.
Legacy Homes had pre-tax income of $8.8 million on sales of $84 million in 1996, compared with pre-tax income of $5.7 million on sales of $62 million in 1995, Monterey said in a statement.

Legacy co-founder John Landon will become chief operating officer and co-chief executive of Monterey Homes. He will be offered a seat on the board of directors, too, and own a major portion of Monterey stock. He will remain based in Texas.

"We are delighted to have John Landon as our partner in growing the company," said William Cleverly, chairman of Monterey. "Our biggest challenge has been finding a company whose financial performance matches that of Monterey, and whose senior executives could bring with them organizational talents and a managerial style that truly complement those of our existing team," Cleverly added.
